items.text: Hey MAVRIX crew

Halloween has descended upon MAVRIX, and we’ve got some spooooooooky surprises waiting for you on the mountain! We’re bringing you seasonal cosmetics, a brand-new trick, fresh freeride content and the slick design from our community hoodie competition just dropped too.
Let’s get into it…
🎃 NEW – Halloween Seasonal Drop 👻
MAVRIX or Treat? Tbh we're just here for the tricks. Anywho, now that terrible pun is outta the way, things are getting spooky out there…
Spooky Trail Dressing: All your fave trails have had a Halloween makeover!
New Time of Day - Frightful fog: The mountain has disappeared into an eerie Halloween mist. Head into the fog… if you dare.
Halloween Cosmetics: Hitting the trails or going trick or treating? Well now you can do 2 in 1 as we’ve got some new time-limited seasonal cosmetics for you.
Halloween Collectibles: Hunt down the seasonal collectibles scattered around the world and collect them all to unlock an exclusive cosmetic reward.
Happy Halloweening out there!
🌀 NEW TRICK – Cork Flips are in!
Time to take things sideways because yup, that’s right, Cork Flips have officially landed, complete with Rob Warner commentary to call out your latest sends.
We’ve also reworked trick, stale trick and spin scoring to encourage more varied riding. Mix up your tricks, switch up your spins and find new ways to rack up those scores!
🏆 IMPORTANT – Slopestyle Leaderboard Reset
With the addition of Cork Flips and our updated trick scoring, we’re resetting the Slopestyle leaderboard as part of this release.
We know those scores matter, but the changes listed above mean it’s time for a fresh start. Get back out there, find your flow and put down some new big hitters.
👕 HOODIE WINNER - Winning Design is in!
You designed them, you voted for your favourites, and now the winner is immortalised in-game.
The devs over at TKG also had a soft spot for the cow design too, so the exciting news is that both the winning community hoodie design from Apex and B8lueberry have made their way to the shop!
A massive thank you to everyone who submitted a design and voted over on Discord. We loved seeing the creativity rolling in.
There’s more fresh gear to grab, too, with the Helfare 9 Lives Top joining the collection.
🏰 NEW – More Freeride Lines!
There are three fresh freeride lines waiting to be discovered on the mountain. Go get 'em, champs!
🚵 GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS
We’ve made a few more tweaks to keep your riding feeling smooth:
Spin Landings: Improved landing leniency to give you a little more forgiveness when bringing those rotations back down to earth.
TableTop Animations: Improved animation easing for smoother movement.
⚙️ IMPROVEMENTS & BUG FIXES
We’ve also been working on performance, stability and a few fixes across the game:
Server Performance: Improvements to general server performance to tackle rubber banding and lag spikes, especially during MAVRIX Cups.
Performance & Quality Modes: Improvements to both visual modes.
Xbox Stability: Fixed crashes that could occur when rapidly switching visual modes.
Darkfest: Fixed an exploit involving the tunnel wall.
Online Play: Improved server backfill and matchmaking reliability.
Localisation: Corrected the German Helfare Sheet challenge text, with Backflip replacing Frontflip.
Slopestyle: As players finish the last section they are brought together to watch the other players finishing.
General art polish: Floating trees, dodgy rocks, that sort of thing.
As always, keep the feedback coming and keep us up to date with how you’re finding the latest release. Have a SPOOKTACULAR time our there.
See you on the trails, legends! 🕸️
The MAVRIX Team

Hey MAVRIX crew!

We’ve got another update rolling out, with a big focus on making Head to Head racing smoother, improving how the bikes feels out there on the mountain, and - as usual - tackling a bunch of bugs, feedback and quality-of-life upgrades.
Let’s get into it…
RACE EVEN HARDER – ✨ Head to Head polish ✨
We’ve been putting Head To Head through its paces and making some changes to improve the race flow from start to finish, just in case you should face plant mid-race... 👀
Improved resets after crashes, failed jumps and leaving the track.
Resetting in Head to Head now gives you a rolling start, and sped up the reset time.
RIDING & TRICKS IMPROVEMENTS🐰 🌀
We’ve also been tuning the bikes and tricks to make riding feel more consistent, especially when you’re really pushing the bike to its limits at speed.
Improved bunny hops at higher speeds and during suspension compression.
More consistent speed-tuck activation, with more forgiving cancellation.
Reduced unwanted forward rotation when dropping from platforms at low speeds.
Added a secondary input sector for the No-Foot Can trick extension.
Bunny hopping off jumps is now more forgiving and consistent.
QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATES
Hider Player Name Plates 🫣
Want a little less clutter while you ride? You can now choose to hide player nameplates in the settings.
This has been one of our most requested quality of life changes so we hope it makes competing during MAVRIX Cups a little more streamlined for you all!
Fast Travel Icons 🔍
Fast travel destinations now have an icon on the map to make it easier to find them.
🪲 BUG FIXES
As ever, we’ve been hard at work clearing out bugs and ironing our smaller issues across the mountain.
Tutorials, Controls & Localisation
Fixed the tutorial pause menu remaining on screen after replaying lesson steps.
Fixed map access between completing a tutorial lesson and loading the next one.
Improved tutorial loading transitions and lesson handoffs.
Fixed untranslated text across Flow controls, tutorial messaging and New and Owned item tags.
Fixed pedal input becoming unassigned when changing the Front Brake binding while using Flow controls.
Improved the progress-wipe screen used for future releases.
Gameplay & Riding
Fixed players spawning in trees after resetting.
Fixed a flip-and-whip combination before the Big Timber checkpoint that could prevent the trick from ending correctly.
Fixed the Matt Jones Signature downhill bike skin being used on an Enduro bike.
World & Performance
Fixed a significant performance stutter when riding on Pineapple Hits.
Fixed a floating rock near Chairlift Juliet.
Rebuilt world data to support the latest freeride lines.
Made further performance improvements to player nameplates and material updates.
UI & Menus
Fixed an issue where a popup could become impossible to dismiss when appearing immediately after another popup.
As always, keep the feedback coming and keep us up to date in Discord with how you’re finding the latest release!
See you on the trails, legends!
— The MAVRIX Team
A quick hotfix to solve an exploit found on the Slopestyle trail Big Timber
Hey MAVRIX crew
It’s time to roll out our next update and this time we're giving you more ways to ride and more ways to customise your look!
This update introduces a brand-new choice of controls, improvements to the First-Time User Experience, a smoother Shop experience, and a stack of fresh cosmetics to get your hands on.
Plus you can now try on your gear and equip it straight from the Shop… Ooo fancy. 👀
Let's get into it...
🎮 NEW – Choose How You Ride
We've added support for a new control scheme, giving you more choice over how you want to ride MAVRIX:
Pro Controls
Our existing control scheme for riders who want full control over the bike and every move.
🆕 Flow Controls
A new way to ride, designed to give players a more simplified option for getting out on the mountain.
You'll be able to choose between Pro and Flow Controls, with updated menus to help make the differences between the two nice and clear.
👀 NEW – Check Your Vibe From Every Angle

Want to check out your new purchase from every angle to see if it’s your vibe? Good, because you can now rotate and zoom your rider in the Shop and Customisation screens, making it easier to check out exactly what you're buying and how your latest look comes together.
Go on. Give yourself a spin... 💃
✨ NEW - Cosmetics

For all your fashionistas out there, we got you covered! The latest update brings some absolute bangers to the shop, with a new batch of clothing, bike skins and accessories. We’re very excited to see some of these hurtling down the trails.

After your first lesson, you'll now get more information about the available control schemes and can choose whether to continue with the lessons or skip ahead and hit the mountain.
We've also fixed a couple of issues with the FTUE.

MAVRIX 15.1 – New Lines, New Rides & More! [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/16.0/google-medium/1f6b5-200d-2642-fe0f@2x.png" style="height: 1.2em; width: 1.2em; vertical-align: text-bottom"][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/16.0/google-medium/1f525@2x.png" style="height: 1.2em; width: 1.2em; vertical-align: text-bottom"]
Hey MAVRIX crew!
We’ve got a fresh new update rolling out, bringing fresh freeride content, new cosmetics, more RVs and campers, plus a whole load of improvements across the mountain.

We’ve also been busy behind the scenes making the First-Time User Experience smoother, improving matchmaking reliability, and polishing plenty of those little details that make MAVRIX feel better to play.
Let’s get down to it...

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/16.0/google-medium/1f6b5-200d-2642-fe0f@2x.png" style="height: 1.2em; width: 1.2em; vertical-align: text-bottom"] NEW – 4 Freeride Lines
Fancy finding some fresh lines?
We’ve added four brand-new freeride routes to the mountain, giving you even more places to explore, session and send it.
Get out there and show us what you can find!
Because of this, we have reset player positions back to the RV Car Park
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/16.0/google-medium/1f690@2x.png" style="height: 1.2em; width: 1.2em; vertical-align: text-bottom"] NEW – More RVs & Campers
More places to call in and give your rider a glow up!
We’ve added extra RVs and campers across the world, giving you more options to customise your setup and make the freshest 'fits on the mountain. Speaking of which…
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/16.0/google-medium/1f455@2x.png" style="height: 1.2em; width: 1.2em; vertical-align: text-bottom"] NEW – Fresh Cosmetics
Time for a fresh look? We've added 5 new cosmetic items to the game, including:
2 new bike skins
3 new helmets
Get them equipped and go show them off!
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/16.0/google-medium/1f9ed@2x.png" style="height: 1.2em; width: 1.2em; vertical-align: text-bottom"] IMPROVED – Finding Your Way
We've made some improvements to help you navigate MAVRIX, particularly when you're just getting started.
Improved route highlighting.
Clearer highlighting for important Compass items.
Improved directions towards Chairlifts.
Finding your next line should now be a little easier.

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/16.0/google-medium/1f393@2x.png" style="height: 1.2em; width: 1.2em; vertical-align: text-bottom"] IMPROVED – First-Time User Experience
We've continued to polish the First-Time User Experience (FTUE) to make getting into MAVRIX clearer and smoother for all our new players.
We've made improvements to onboarding, tutorials, route guidance and messaging to help new riders get up to speed without getting in the way of the riding.

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/16.0/google-medium/1f310@2x.png" style="height: 1.2em; width: 1.2em; vertical-align: text-bottom"] IMPROVED – Matchmaking & Multiplayer
We've been doing some work behind the scenes to improve the reliability of matchmaking and multiplayer.
Reducing failed matchmaking attempts.
Improving how the game handles reconnecting to servers.
Better handling of empty or unsuccessful lobbies.
General matchmaking and server stability improvements.
That means less waiting around and more riding.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/16.0/google-medium/1f41e@2x.png" style="height: 1.2em; width: 1.2em; vertical-align: text-bottom"] BUG FIXES
We've also been busy squashing bugs across the mountain, such as:
Fixed slow scrolling on the EULA screen on console.
Fixed an issue where players could load into a server using an invalid Join Code.
Fixed a PlayStation progression issue where conquered regions could award XP too early and too frequently.
Fixed incorrect MAVRIX Cup reward information appearing for some PlayStation and Xbox players.
Plus a whole host of other gameplay, UI, environment and platform fixes.
That’s everything for now, but work is already underway for our net update which will look at additional control schemes, shop updates and a fresh drop of cosmetics.
Go find our new freeride routes, check out the latest gear at the new RV sites, and see how the improvements feel.
See you on the trails, legends! [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/16.0/google-medium/1f525@2x.png" style="height: 1.2em; width: 1.2em; vertical-align: text-bottom"]
— The MAVRIX Team

items.text: MAVRIX Hotfix – 15.0.2 🛠️
Hey MAVRIX crew!
We've got another hotfix rolling out today, bringing a range of improvements across progression, multiplayer, UI and platform features.
Thanks again to everyone who's been sharing feedback since Full Release, all your input keeps on helping us make the mountain an even better place to ride.
🏆 Achievements & Progression
We've made a number of improvements to progression and trophy tracking:
Fixed issues affecting player-level trophy progression.
Resolved Early Access edge cases preventing trophy unlocks for Tech Legend, Work Smarter, Not Harder, and Downhill bike-related progression.
Improved accuracy between your displayed player level and actual Rider Rank.
🌐 Multiplayer & Gameplay

notes.title: We've continued polishing the online experience with

items.text: Improved Join Code handling to reduce issues connecting with friends.
Head-to-Head - Better timing for the Head-to-Head ‘play again’ prompt after finishing a Head to Head race.
Slopestyle - Fixed an incorrect message displaying after checkpoint countdown expires.
🖥️ UI & Quality of Life
A few quality-of-life improvements have also made their way into this update:
Fixed the Skip Lesson icon placement in translated languages.
Resolved German text overflow on Race and Time Trial results.
Improved Shop UI readability for Fast Travel Pass ownership indicators on PlayStation 5 and Xbox.
🎮 Platform Improvements
We've also made improvements to player profiles by enabling profile access directly from:
Leaderboards
The Report Player screen
Thanks again for all your support and feedback. We'll continue listening, improving, and keeping the updates rolling.
See you on the mountain, legends! 🚵‍♂️🔥
— The MAVRIX Team
Hey MAVRIX crew!

Since launching into Full Release, you've been sending us loads of feedback, bug reports and clips, and we've been hard at work getting fixes shipped out the door as quickly as possible. So, massive thanks for all your input 🫶
This hotfix focuses on server improvements, animation polish, and blocked challenge fixes. Full details are covered off below.
⚙️ IMPROVEMENTS
🌐 Server & Multiplayer Performance
We've improved the performance of multiplayer servers so that servers shouldn’t drop below 60fps, alongside improvements for join codes and getting you guys on to the same servers.
🎮 Gameplay Polish

notes.title: We've continued refining the feel of riding with

items.text: Smoother transitions into drift animations.
Improved skid particle effects when drifting.
Additional loading screen tips throughout the game.
Improvements to backend server handling for a more reliable online experience.
🐞 BUG FIXES
🏁 Gameplay & Bike Feel
Fixed an issue where landing spins could unexpectedly send riders off course.
Reduced overly aggressive hip assist during flips for more predictable landings.
Fixed several Sponsor Challenges that could progress incorrectly while simply airborne.
Fixed an issue where Head-to-Head Slopestyle players could respawn at the wrong checkpoint after bailing near the finish.
👀 First-Person Camera & Animation
We've polished a number of first-person animations, including fixes for:
Arm clipping while using air control.
Scrub animations where the arm looks unnatural.
Hand and finger positioning during high-speed riding, leaning and riding backwards.
🖥️ UI & Menus
Fixed a black screen that could occur after leaving the Shop from the pause menu.
Fixed a rare black screen after completing Pineapple Hits Slopestyle.
Fixed the Slopestyle score widget incorrectly displaying "Rival" when no rival was active.
Improved German localisation for MAVRIX Cup UI.
The build/version number is now displayed on the main menu, making it easier to identify which version you're running when reporting issues.
🌍 World & Visuals
Fixed the default sun position so lighting now appears as intended.
Fixed the Time of Day setting so lighting updates correctly when adjusted.
🎮 Platform & Online
Fixed an issue when joining multiplayer sessions via the Xbox Game Bar.
Improved online reliability through better handling of backend rate limits and retries.
As always, thank you for continuing to send us your feedback. Every report helps us make MAVRIX better, and we'll keep working on improvements as we continue supporting and evolving the game.
See you on the mountain, legends. 🚵‍♂️🔥
— The MAVRIX Team

Hey MAVRIX crew!
This update is dropping in hot with two brand-new Slopestyle trails, plus a stack of new freeride lines to discover. PLUS we’ve got a bunch of bug fixes going in too.
Our next planned big update will be exiting Early Access, so stay tuned for some big news!!!
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/15.0/google-medium/1fab5@2x.png"]NEW – Big Timber Slopestyle Trail
Welcome to Big Timber - a brand-new Slopestyle trail built for massive take-offs, huge air time and a whole lot of room for big scores.
Show us your best tricks and see if you’ve got what it takes to master one of the newest additions to the mountain.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/15.0/google-medium/1f525@2x.png"]NEW – 8-Pack Slopestyle Trail

Say hello to 8-Pack, another fresh Slopestyle playground designed to really test your skills. While it may look easy to complete, getting those high scores is going to be a LOT trickier than you think.
Let’s see who’s got what it takes…
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/15.0/google-medium/1f30d@2x.png"] NEW – Freeride Lines
Explorers, this one’s for you. We’ve added several new freeride routes across the mountain, giving riders even more creative ways to carve their own path:
4 new freeride lines starting from the Jolly Good start gate
PLUS a new Spider freeride line hidden in the basin behind Pineapple Hits
AND ‘29 Jumps’, a fresh freeride line near Waterfall’s Edge built for nonstop airtime
Go find them, session them, and show us what you create!
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/15.0/google-medium/1f41e@2x.png"]BUG FIXES & POLISH
Alongside the new content, we’ve rolled out a range of fixes and improvements across the mountain:
World & Environment
Fixed grass visibly popping in and out while riding.
Resolved terrain holes and geometry issues near Dragon’s Back.
Fixed placeholder geometry appearing under the River Gap Technical Challenge.
Addressed collision and asset issues in rocky areas south of Steeze Mountain.
Fixed Z-fighting (visual glitch) issues near the Don’t Hang Up trail.
Trails & Collision
Removed unintended collision from some race, Slopestyle, and MAVRIX Cup dressing assets.
Fixed unnecessary collision on flag banners in Forest Jam.
Addressed terrain and collision issues on Pineapple Hits and Pineapple Hits B-Side.
Visuals & Presentation
Fixed first-person motion blur causing tyres to disappear at speed.
Corrected duplicate Pro-Rider cut-outs appearing in the Farmlands region.
General visual polish and asset clean-up across multiple trails and freeride areas.
So What’s Next?
The next one is a big one. Like, a REALLY big one. Our next planned update will officially launch us out of Early Access and into Full Release!
Stay tuned as more details drop. We’ll share them here as soon as we can.
See you on the mountain, legends

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/15.0/google-medium/1f6b5-200d-2642-fe0f@2x.png"][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/15.0/google-medium/1f525@2x.png"]- The MAVRIX Team

BUT you’ll need to explore the world to find it. By tracking down hidden, MAVRIX collectable letters across the map, you can unlock the UNCONTAINED Bike Park, a fresh space built for our most dedicated riders.
Alongside that, we’re introducing Rider Rank, a new progression system that rewards you throughout MAVRIX. Full details dropped below ...
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/15.0/google-medium/1f3c6@2x.png"] NEW – Rider Rank
Your rider journey just got an upgrade!
Earn XP as you ride and complete challenges, and as you rank up you’ll unlock a mix of cosmetic rewards and gameplay upgrades.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/15.0/google-medium/1f30d@2x.png"]NEW – Open World Collectables
Time to explore like never before! We’ve added collectables across the world to reward curious riders:
Smash through Pro Rider cut-outs scattered across the map
Hunt down all the hidden MAVRIX letters
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/15.0/google-medium/1f513@2x.png"] Unlock the UNCONTAINED Bike Park
Collect every hidden MAVRIX collectable letter and you’ll gain access to the brand new UNCONTAINED Bike Park, an exclusive riding zone. This place is SICK!
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/15.0/google-medium/2699-fe0f@2x.png"] IMPROVEMENTS
First-person camera animations overhauled to reduce clipping and improve visuals.
Implemented separate front and rear braking animations for more realistic control.
Grass environment re-enabled following performance improvements.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/15.0/google-medium/1f41e@2x.png"] BUG FIXES
We’ve continued our work with general polish and stability improvements across MAVRIX, as well as the below fixes.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/15.0/google-medium/1f3ae@2x.png"] Gameplay & Physics
Fixed issues with wheelies and manuals causing visual glitches and incorrect body positioning.
Resolved cases where players would bail unexpectedly when dropping in from ramps.
Player now correctly resets when riding into lakes.
Fixed an issue where holding forward on the right stick increased straight-line speed unintentionally.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/15.0/google-medium/1f440@2x.png"] First-Person Camera & Animation
Fixed missing hands and arm clipping during tricks and animations.
Resolved hoodie clipping and camera shake after bails.
Fixed rider shadow appearing with unnatural proportions.
Improved consistency across speed tuck and trick animations in first person.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/15.0/google-medium/1f30d@2x.png"] World & Visuals
Fixed floating objects including wooden beams and environment assets.
Addressed low-resolution textures on rocks and path edges.
Fixed issues with HLods rendering, including missing lakes and distant objects appearing incorrectly.
Chairlift cables now align correctly with base station wheels.
Fixed moving road surfaces and lorry visibility issues.
Addressed missing particle effects on PS5.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/15.0/google-medium/1f3c1@2x.png"] Trails, Events & Challenges
Fixed players discovering inaccessible regions prematurely.
Fixed incorrect collision on rocks at the start of Slim Jim.
Resolved a bypass issue on part of the Poop Shoot challenge.
Fixed misplaced difficulty icon on Crazy Train.
Removed MAVRIX Cup dressing where no event was active.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/15.0/google-medium/1f5a5-fe0f@2x.png"] UI, FTUE & Audio
Fixed missing subtitles in the RV intro.
Corrected incorrect trick naming in FTUE lessons.
Resolved UI overlap issues with FTUE and leaderboard.
Fixed idle warnings triggering incorrectly.
This update opens up a whole new way to play MAVRIX, whether you’re grinding XP or hunting down collectables to unlock the new bike park. Time to get out there and earn it!

This hotfix addresses an issue seen primarily at the start of the Darkfest trail where trick animations can get stuck if you land on a berm mid-trick.

This hotfix addresses a couple of playability issues in the opening section of the Darkfest trail and some collision issues with slopestyle event assets. It also reduces the clipping of clothing items through the first-person camera.
MAVRIX Update – RIDE THE LEGENDARY DARKFEST TRAIL, and more....
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f1ff-1f1e6@2x.png"]Hey MAVRIX crew!

This update is a massive moment for MAVRIX. For the first time ever, we’re bringing a real-world MTB event into the game with the arrival of Darkfest - one of the most legendary freeride events on the planet that is happening right now IRL! We’ve built an entirely new mountain just for this.
We’ve got a NEW TECH CHALLENGE for you too! Complete Slim Jim to unlock fast travel straight to Helfare Hotrod, but be warned…it’s called Slim Jim for a reason, so thread the line cleanly.
As ever, we’ve got a bunch of bug fixes going in thanks to your feedback. More detail on everything below.
Get out there and send it… if you dare.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f30d@2x.png"] NEW – Darkfest Trail
The legendary Darkfest event has landed in MAVRIX.

Known for its huge jumps, insane airtime, and next-level freeride lines, Darkfest is an IRL event hosted over in South Africa that pushes riders to their absolute limits. Unlocking in-game as real-world pro riders test what’s possible on two-wheels in the 10th anniversary of the now-legendary event, the Darkfest trail is now yours to ride.
It’s our first ever IRL track in-game and we are STOKED.

notes.title: To bring this trail to life we’ve added

items.text: A brand new mountain behind the Helfarm
A dedicated chairlift to take riders to the top
A Slopestyle event built around the trail’s massive features
Let’s see how many of you can handle one of the most iconic freeride setups ever built.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f3af@2x.png"] NEW – Slim Jim Tech Challenge
Now introducing Slim Jim: a brand-new Tech Challenge that is all about testing your technical precision and putting your bike handling skills to the test.

If (and that’s a big if!) you can make it to the end of the challenge, you’ll unlock fast-travel access to Helfare Hotrod, making it much easier to drop straight into one of our most popular race trails.
Who will be the first to conquer Slim Jim? Over to you…
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f41e@2x.png"] Bug Fixes & Polish
Alongside the new content, we’ve rolled out a large number of fixes and improvements across the game based on your feedback.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f30d@2x.png"] World & Environment
Multiple world-related fixes for things like floating assets and clipping.
Addressed lighting issues.
Improved collisions and rock placements.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f3c1@2x.png"] Trails, Events & Gameplay
Fixed several Slopestyle exploits where players could repeat jumps or gain extra trick opportunities.
Fixed issues allowing players to skip sections of certain Tech Challenges.
Improved spawn and respawn behaviour across multiple events.
Fixed race boundary resets on several trails.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f3ae@2x.png"] UI, Challenges & Progression
Fixed issues where MAVRIX Cup rewards were not granted when joining a server.
Resolved cases where sponsor challenges UI could appear blank after suspend/resume on consoles.
Fixed several missing or incorrect UI elements across Slopestyle and event interfaces.
Corrected text errors and missing translations across several prompts and lessons.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f6e0-fe0f@2x.png"] Visuals & Presentation
Fixed arm clipping in first-person at high speeds.
Addressed dirt VFX appearing above the ground during certain tricks.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f527@2x.png"] Console & Stability
Fixed several console-specific UI and level issues on PlayStation and Xbox.
Addressed collision, spawn, and environment inconsistencies affecting console builds.
Improved stability when interacting with events, lessons, and world traversal systems.

The addition of DarkFest marks the first time we’ve brought a real-world MTB event into MAVRIX, and it’s something we’re mega hyped about. As always, keep the feedback coming! Be sure to let us know what you think after sending the Darkfest jumps. See you on the mountain, legends.

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f6b5-200d-2642-fe0f@2x.png"][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f525@2x.png"]— Matt, Jono & The MAVRIX Team

releases.displayName: HUGE UPDATE OUT NOW: Slopestyle, Tricks, Physics & Tutorial

items.text: Hey MAVRIX crew!

Our latest update mark a HUGE milestone for MAVRIX. Alongside the launch of Slopestyle mode, and a whole host of new tricks, we’re also delivering major upgrades to bike physics, animations and a brand new tutorial.
This update is all about expression, flow, and dialling in bike control. Let’s get into it.
Slopestyle Mode Has Landed
Slopestyle is officially here! This new mode opens up leaderboards across all trails, letting you compete based on style, trick choice, and flow - not just speed.
To match the vibe, we’ve added THREE brand-new Slopestyle-focused trails:
Triple 9
Don’t Hang Up
Hips Don’t Lie
We’ve expanded your trick arsenal with six new extension tricks, giving you more ways to style out your runs:
Tuck No-Hander
Superman Seatgrab
Tabletop
No Foot Can (Downhill bike only)
Barspin (Enduro bike only)
Tailwhip (Enduro bike only)
3 new Slopestyle trails as listed above.
New free ride areas added in the quarry and around the latest trails.
A peak-to-peak gondola and additional chairlifts make getting around the mountain faster and smoother.
We’ve made a big push on bike feel and realism in this latest update. You can expect:
New landing animations for smoother, more natural touchdowns.
Hip assist tech helps guide you into landings that aren’t perfectly lined up.
Added rider suspension, allowing some impact force to be absorbed through the rider.
New bike animations for speed tuck, speed tuck fail, and right-stick leaning.
Improved max pedal animation for better power delivery.
Whip size is now based on input rotation size, not how long it’s held.
More rider lean added to the right stick for improved handling

notes.title: Learn the Ride - Tutorial Just Dropped

items.text: New riders, we’ve got you covered. Our new Bike Controls tutorial helps players get comfortable with riding, handling, and core mechanics right from the start.
New Red Bull sponsor track added.
Existing sponsors now feature additional progression levels, with unique rewards waiting at the top tiers.
Updated race line boundaries on select trails.
Controls screen now includes a dedicated Advanced Controls page showing all tricks clearly.
These updates represent a massive step forward for MAVRIX. Later today we'll be welcoming loads of new Riders as we'll be launching on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, which is so exciting.
As with all previous updates, leaderboards have been reset. Time to get some new records on the boards!
As always, keep the feedback coming, and we’ll see you out there, legends.
Big love
— Matt, Jono & the MAVRIX Team [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f6b5-200d-2642-fe0f@2x.png"]

topNew: 3 new Slopestyle trails as listed above.
New free ride areas added in the quarry and around the latest trails.
A peak-to-peak gondola and additional chairlifts make getting around the mountain faster and smoother.

items.text: Hey MAVRIX crew!

We’ve got a tidy little update for you today, bringing the truck stunt that took the internet by storm last week into MAVRIX, plus some fresh goggle options, and a handful of fixes to keep your ride smooth.
Let’s dive in!
Time to channel your inner Matt Jones.
Two trucks are circling the MAVRIX map. They’ll cross over for a brief window in time, giving you the perfect chance to recreate that insane truck-jump moment…
Line it up, send it, and send it even harder.
Here's Matt giving the lowdown on how we recreated this moment in Mavrix:
Head to our TikTok or Instagram to watch Matt’s generational crashout as he attempts to land this trick in the game
Fresh colours, fresh style. A selection of new goggle colourways has landed in the store so you can fine-tune your look for the trail.
MAVRIX Cup race dressing has now been added to all remaining race trails for a fully unified event experience.
Fixed an issue causing unnatural shadows to appear across the world.
MAVRIX Cup UI now correctly turns off when the event ends, even if you’re mid-race when it finishes.
Rob Warner’s Mavrix Cup commentary is now better balanced with the other race commentary.
Shop and inventory icons will no longer appear blurred when the screens are first opened
AND JUST ONE MORE THING…
Stay tuned, legends — we’ve got a BIG update dropping in January, packed with new content and major improvements.
You won’t want to miss this one.
~ Team Mavrix

topNew: MAVRIX Cup race dressing has now been added to all remaining race trails for a fully unified event experience.

items.text: Hey crew! We’ve just rolled out a hotfix patch to smooth out a few bumps following the 11.0.0 update. Thanks for all your reports and feedback — here’s what’s been fixed and polished:
FIXES
Fixed a broken error screen that appeared when the leaderboard API timed out.
Tree collision fixed on Forest Jam section 5 — no more underground trunks.
Using the rear brake skid no longer breaks the hard-brake animation.
MAVRIX Cup placement rewards now correctly grant to all eligible players.
Fixed an issue where Restart Race during a bail could kick players out of race mode.
Resolved a softlock when opening and selecting any option in the Pause Menu right after a MAVRIX Cup notification.
Fixed a mismatch between the leaderboard and a player’s best times in the race UI.
Smoothed out a visible seam on a berm in Helfare Hotrod.
Shimano Sheet 17 – Challenge 3 now correctly requires a 40m stoppie (text previously said 70m).
Removed MAVRIX Cup assets appearing in standard races on Bon Voyage and Forest Jam.
The MAVRIX Cup leaderboard can now be interacted with.
Patched terrain spikes and holes in the editor.
Pressing X (Xbox controller) / Square (PS controller) now correctly pedals as indicated in the controls.
Thanks for keeping the feedback coming and helping us keep the trails running smooth. See you out there, legends!
— The MAVRIX Team
This hotfix addresses three issues following our 11.0.0 release
Fixed a potential issue with brakes not working on reverse brake setups
Fixed a potential issue with reward allocation for Mavrix cup
Fixed an issue where users sometimes timed out during matchmaking

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f3c1@2x.png"]Hey MAVRIX crew! It’s time to buckle up and hit the trails because update 11.0.0 is here, and it’s all about racing. We’ve got MAVRIX Cup (more on that below) dropping in hot, a brand-new sponsor partnership, new trails, and fresh customisation gear all in this latest update. Let’s jump into the details!
WHAT’S NEW?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/c04b64ae3f04cc033fab4e3ece52dc06fd2811c0.png"]
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f3c6@2x.png"] MAVRIX CUP – Get your race on
We’re so stoked to bring you MAVRIX Cup, our brand-new timed event series!

Race to glory on select trails, with rewards for all entrants and a special Red Bull helmet waiting for the fastest rider out there. It all kicks off on Helfare Hot Rod, but keep your eyes peeled – the Cup will roll out across other trails soon.

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/2699-fe0f@2x.png"][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f527@2x.png"] Shimano joins the crew
We’re pumped to welcome Shimano as a new sponsor!

Complete challenges on the Shimano sponsor track to unlock upgraded brakes and equip them in the ‘Bike Setup’ menu, as well as the usual Moolah rewards for completing challenges. XT and XTR brakes are up for grabs!
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f440@2x.png"] Look behind you

Ever wonder who’s chasing your line? Is the train still behind you? Now you can check! Press Down on the D-Pad to glance back mid-ride – pretty handy for keeping tabs on the competition or just showing off your style.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/26f0-fe0f@2x.png"] New Race Trail: Ridget Jones

Say hello to Ridget Jones, our newest track on the mountain! This fresh new race trail follows an exposed ridge, built for speed, flow, and fierce competition. Once you’ve discovered it, hit the leaderboard and show everyone who owns this ridge.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/2728@2x.png"] New customisation gear

notes.title: Time to freshen up your fit

items.text: Retro Race Kit – throwback style meets modern performance.
Helfare Rival Jerseys – two new colourways to keep things fresh.
New Gloves – brand new gloves to complete your look.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/2699-fe0f@2x.png"] IMPROVEMENTS
We’ve been hard at work under the hood with tweaks, polish, and performance upgrades:
Improved right-stick leaning functionality.
Steering animations refined for a more natural feel.
Reduced camera shake on smaller landings for better clarity.
Sponsor screen (on the pause menu) now supports more than three sponsors.
Particle effects expanded to cover more terrain/surface types.
Character face skins reworked for improved detail and realism.
Backflip animation tuned so your rider keeps their head aligned mid-flip.
Scrubbing a jump now compresses your bike more, perfect for racing.
New free-ride lines added from Chairlift Golf and between The Deep End and the Farm.
Various optimisations, including UI textures converted to power-of-2 sizing.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f41e@2x.png"] BUG FIXES
Minor UI fixes across map and sponsor screens.
Fixed multiple instances of floating foliage.
Race boundaries fixed on Jolly Good and Waterfall’s Edge to fix issue with players failing the race when jumping higher than the boundary
Resolved missing translation text in FIGS languages.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/26a0-fe0f@2x.png"] Known Issue

After updating to MAVRIX 11.0.0, some players may experience a timeout when joining a server for the first time. If this happens, just retry your connection and you should get straight in.We’re on it, and a hotfix is coming soon!
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4dd@2x.png"] NOTES
Leaderboards have been reset as part of this update.
What’s next?
The MAVRIX Cup is just the beginning – we’ve got plenty more racing action, challenges, and gear drops on the horizon. Did someone mention slopestyle...?
Your feedback is what keeps us rolling, so jump into our Discord and let us know what you think:
See you on the mountain, legends.
— Matt, Jono & the MAVRIX Team
Summary
This update adds 4 new languages to the game - French, Italian, German and Spanish are now all available to choose from the settings menu.
New Features
Players who played the game before 11th September 2025 will be granted a new custom white bike skin for the Downhill bike.
Improvements to existing features
EOS SDK updated to 1.17.1.3
New languages added to the language selection toggle in the settings menu
This hotfix addresses two issues following our 10.0.0 release
We’ve increased the matchmaking timeout to reduce the number of people who are seeing the ‘Seatpost’ error after hitting the PLAY button.
The player’s DLSS setting will now be retained when they quit the game so it doesn’t have to be re-enabled each time.

releases.displayName: MAJOR UPDATE - Community Response - NOW LIVE!

items.text: Riders!!! We're so stoked to drop our first HUGE update, now LIVE! It's been amazing seeing feedback since our Early Access launch 1 month ago. We've been hard at work to implement key updates and features based on that very same feedback. So, here's what's new!
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f32a-fe0f@2x.png"]
Starting with 360's! These are triggered by pushing both sticks to the left or right. So, just like flips, these can be held for 720's, 1080's, or released to slow down rotation and land perfectly.
Now that spins are in MAVRIX, we'll start work on tweaking the rotation axis for dipped/dumped spins. We're excited to add some serious style to these! Please do let us know what you think!

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/42c7a50bdfb209ce178861d605caef429d6e5611.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/c7ba3c59aae6d4db78f4bc3ba7f883d2d77fb517.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/f307d5f805523528099cef73630447177ae476a7.png"]

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4cd@2x.png"]Session/respawn markers! You asked - we delivered. Drop a marker anywhere by pressing ‘Y’ / Triangle, then hold the same button to fast travel right back. Explore without losing your favourite spots! True freeride has arrived. Note, these currently have a 1km limit to encourage exploration with chairlifts. As ever, community feedback is welcomed to fine tune this!

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-large/1f6b2@2x.png"]Huge Suspension Enhancements! Not only have we improved our bike's suspension, the animation has been improved too. This means you now see the suspension moving over bumps/rocks/roots.

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/23e9@2x.png"]Speed tuck mechanic! Compress the right stick to adopt a streamlined tuck position, boosting your speed. Racing is getting serious!

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f5fa-fe0f@2x.png"]Map Waypoints! Open the map and set your next destination with waypoint markers to help you navigate the world with ease. Multiple waypoints can be placed / removed.

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-large/1f9d8-200d-2642-fe0f@2x.png"]We've smoothed handlebar steering in POV. It was obvious that this looked twitchy before, which was picked up by viewers of our video content too. POV mode now looks and feels much smoother - this is extra noticeable when fine tuning steering on our new tech challenge.....

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/77f2a1826de5b0538760d2adec1a1434963c6ab1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/1d730e1fa7625f48e3c16f112a5e16d1aaa1bebd.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/a7ad349fa22766dc3f20a96621f7af159ed6fb23.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/712570e7d963fe29f355ba5f4b62cf2e6abc32b1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/e670a373900407b35616c3efe3f32d4d2bd8af22.png"]
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f682@2x.png"]

New Race Track! Introducing Crazy Train.... inspired by our most popular race track in Mavrix, Helfare Hot Rod, this is 1 minute of pure speed! With a technical lower section featuring a whole new UCI Downhill inspired path type, racing is going to be intense! This major update will coincide with a leaderboard reset, to keep racing fair as the tracks are updated and short-cuts removed.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f30a@2x.png"]

New tech challenge! 'The Deep End'! Tactically situated near Creek Side and Forest Jam, this will become a super useful fast-travel point, but only if you can complete it! This one is tough... take a deep breath!
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f6a1@2x.png"]
2x New Chairlift! No more long uphill pedal sessions! These two new chairlifts will get you straight to Dragons Back and Bon Voyage, so you can focus on what matters... the race back down!
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-large/26f0-fe0f@2x.png"]
A whole new mountain! Positioned behind Bon Voyage, this mountain also has a fresh freeride area giving riders a chance to put the new session markers to work!
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-large/1f918@2x.png"]
New Sponsor Challenges means more Moolah available!
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-large/1f6d2@2x.png"]
New shop Items! With new Moolah up for grabs, we've added new Items to the shop. Including flannel shirts, white Five-Ten shoes, PinkEye Sunglasses and even an option to ride gloveless!

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/79d2606c0901cb56f39d2def4cb05213016b0dc0.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/30daf49ead9a416d0b88c9b48d4868c236f19e86.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/8f99a831eb0d1c6987c853cad4e0decaa9dcf753.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/a15f4f491921e56994b58b8e1eec2de06007e9e1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/e9164222bb76d93677d9caf9431ff17735b718b9.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/3dede66d6b702b345e82479c073833917ea9653d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/55e450ec3ae8f0b657ec35020a214f927b085cc3.png"]
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f1e8-1f1f3@2x.png"]
MAVRIX is now playable in Chinese! We've started work on other languages too, which we'll announce in our next update.
Ongoing Performance Optimisation, Enjoy smoother gameplay and better performance with NVIDIA DLSS technology.
Ongoing Bug Fixes
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/2699-fe0f@2x.png"] IMPROVEMENTS
Final checkpoint on Helfare Hot Rod moved uphill for better pacing.
No more reversing at race starts.
Trail refinement, with short-cuts removed. Jolly Good left-hip jump improved for better gameplay!
Price tags now hidden on purchased items for a tidier shop view.
Added haptic feedback for Xbox controllers (toggle off in settings menu).
Post-race experience polished.
AFK players now receive a warning message before being kicked.
Compass icons now scale and fade based on distance to points of interest.
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f41e@2x.png"] BUG FIXES
Main menu FPS is now capped.
Close Encounter Tech Challenge now correctly shows in Flow Fields region on the map region tracker.
Various fixes for collisions and floating landscape assets.
Leaderboard fixes ensure your position is always clearly highlighted.
Fixed a persistent blank retry prompt for players when resetting after going off-trail.
Bike skins now preview perfectly in the shop – no surprises!
Stay tuned because we’re just getting started! Don’t forget, your feedback is crucial. Head over to our Discord and share your thoughts, and help shape the future of MAVRIX:
.Thanks for riding with us — see you on the trails! Legends.
— Matt, Jono & the MAVRIX Team

First post-launch patch

This is the first post-launch release for MAVRIX. It is a patch containing mostly bug fixes for issues related to leaderboards, matchmaking, challenges, some bike controller issues and various other bugs.
• Matchmaking - players will be placed in servers closer to their location, using ping as a guide.
• Removed ‘cinematic’ option from graphics settings as it isn’t intended to be a player-facing option.
Flow Fields region now shows as 100% complete rather than 0%
Players are no longer able to complete sponsor challenges requiring race mode in discovery mode.
The second challenge of Marin sheet 3 (Frontflip, then whip within 10 seconds on trail Dragon’s back) now completes as expected.
When completing the third challenge of Helfare, it is now possible to complete the challenge in the following region.
Marin level 12 Poop Shoot challenge time increased to 28s
Leaderboards - resolved various issues around the leaderboard highlight not highlighting the local player correctly both on the small pre/post-race leaderboard and in the main leaderboard screen.
Fix for bike becoming unresponsive to steering input if the player crashed whilst holding the front brake
Fix for soft-lock if the player interacts with a chairlift whilst respawning
• Fixed bug where paths would occasionally appear with unnatural, often black, textures.
• Removed log file spam related to ‘Rendering a nanite mesh to a runtime virtual texture isn't yet supported.’
• EULA is no longer shown briefly on every startup when launching from Epic Games Launcher.
• Join code functionality now works more reliably.
